title: SOC2 prep - control mapping scratchpad (Priya Kapoor)
content:
Purpose: quick scratchpad mapping of SOC2 common criteria to Redwood systems + open questions for upcoming audit call. Informal notes, not final.

Scope: Redwood hosted + dedicated + private (initial focus on hosted API and dedicated, private later). Need to align evidence locations for each.

High-level plan:
- Draft mapping -> review with SRE + infra -> collect evidence artifacts -> run internal evidence checklist -> share with auditor.
- Target: have baseline mapping + pointers before auditor kickoff (week of 2024-06-10).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Who owns logical access for the hosted control plane? (Is this product infra or security?) @Ethan to confirm.
- Evidence for MFA enforcement on service accounts: where are policy logs stored? (cloud-iam logs + auditd?) TODO: Olivia to pull policy screenshots + cloud logs.
- Data classification: need definitive doc that says what counts as "customer data" vs telemetry. I think Confluence page SEC-Data-Class v2 is draft.
- Encryption at rest evidence: list of KMS keys used across regions and their rotation policy. Noah to ask infra for key inventory.

Preliminary control mappings (very rough):
- CC1: Access controls / logical access
  - Control: user provisioning / deprovisioning (timely revocation)
  - Owner: people-ops (org) for human users; infra for service accounts
  - Evidence: Okta user lifecycle logs (confluence link), IAM policies PRs, onboarding/offboarding runbook (runbook page id: RB-77)
  - Notes: need sample of terminated user deprovisioning within 24 hours – ask People Ops for recent offboarding case.

- CC2: System configuration and change management
  - Control: changes to prod infra require PR review + CI test + canary deploy
  - Owner: release-engineering / platform-engineering
  - Evidence: GitHub PRs with review history (examples: github:repo-infra/ops#512), CI run artifacts, deployment trace in console (console trace ids TBD)
  - Notes: find 2-3 examples from last 90 days; include canary rollback example.

- CC3: Logical separation / multi-tenant isolation (hosted/dedicated/private)
  - Control: tenant routing policies, dedicated pools isolation
  - Owner: serving-runtime + dedicated teams
  - Evidence: architecture diagram, config snippets (nginx/sidecar routing rules), network policies
  - Notes: need to clarify whether dedicated customers get separate namespaces or just isolated pools. Add diagram.

- CC4: Encryption in transit and at rest
  - Control: TLS enforced for all external ports; encryption at rest via cloud KMS
  - Owner: infra
  - Evidence: TLS cert inventory, HSTS config, KMS key list, storage encryption configs (S3 bucket policies)
  - Notes: verify private deployments guidance (on-prem) — doc is different for private.

- CC5: Monitoring / logging / detection
  - Control: central logging, retention policy, alerting thresholds
  - Owner: observability team
  - Evidence: ELK/Grafana dashboards, alert runbooks, retention policy doc (confluence:OBS-RET-2023)
  - Notes: confirm retention for security logs = 1 year? auditor asked about immutable storage for certain logs.

Evidence collection checklist (starter):
- Policy documents (confluence) with last-updated date
- Process/runbook screenshots or excerpts
- Sample logs (redacted) showing enforcement (e.g., denied access)
- Config files (redacted) and PR history linking to change approvals
- Onboarding/offboarding ticket examples (linear/Jira keys)

Risk questions to flag (for auditor prep):
- Service account lifecycle: do we have rotation and least-privilege enforced? (risk: long-lived keys)
- Third-party access: contractors with elevated creds – need list + justification
- Private deployment variance: customers running on-prem may be responsible for some controls; need clear delineation in SOC scope statement.

Quick evidence locations (working):
- Okta admin console screenshots -> stored in /evidence/okta/ (ask security for share)
- KMS keys + policies -> cloud console (create export) and store in evidence bucket
- GitHub PR examples -> links (provide PR ids), download diffs as PDFs if requested by auditor
- Oncall/incident reports -> ops/incident folder (include redacted PII)

Meeting notes to add to this doc after audit sync:
- 2024-06-04 call w/ auditor: confirm scope, highlight private deployment caveat, request evidence template for KMS.
- Action items:
  - Priya: assemble evidence list + start export jobs for logs (due 2024-06-07)
  - Ethan: confirm Okta offboarding SLA and provide examples (due 2024-06-05)
  - Olivia: gather PR samples for CM & infra (due 2024-06-06)
  - Noah: KMS inventory + encryption config (due 2024-06-06)

Notes to self:
- Keep artifacts minimal and redacted where necessary. Auditor prefers CSV manifests for artifacts mapping to control IDs.
- Reconcile control IDs with auditor's template (they use CC-1, CC-2 naming). Map our internal controls to theirs in a separate sheet (not in this scratchpad).

Links & refs (placeholder):
- Confluence: SEC-Policies-2981 (policies)
- Confluence: OBS-RET-2023 (logging retention)
- Jira: SEC-1234 (audit kickoff ticket)
- GitHub PRs: repo-infra/docs#45 (example doc update)

End of scratchpad — move into structured mapping sheet once we have first artifacts.
